lines.text: Saul put the troops under an oath not to eat before evening, so they left the honey alone.
After Israel struck the Philistines from Michmash to Hebron, the troops ate meat with blood, and Saul built an altar.
Saul asked for Urim if the fault was Israel's and Thummim if it was his, and the people were cleared.

wrong_details.wrong: Urim if the fault was Israel's, Thummim if it was Saul's
wrong_details.true: Urim if the fault was with Saul or Jonathan, Thummim if it was with Israel
